fast_profile_settings.detector_resolution: max 640 for white-border sparse pages >=640px; original otherwise

methodology: Fresh process and one initialized engine per trial. Same ordered image bytes. Per-page time includes reading and preprocessing. Total batch includes process startup, model loading, and OCR. One fixed preset per run, without per-page oracle selection. These presets were developed on the same synthetic inputs. No GPU. Rust uses the public library through cpu_latency. Tesseract uses its C API through ctypes. Tesseract process RSS includes the Python ctypes driver. A failed or timed-out configuration is retained and skipped in later trials.

presets.tesseract-document-contrast: Document preset plus 0.5/99.5 percentile luminance stretching when the range spans 12..105 levels, using the contrast-restoration strategy of the Rust engine.
presets.tesseract-otsu: eng+ind, automatic orientation and segmentation (PSM 1), Otsu
presets.tesseract-document: eng+ind, PSM 1, Sauvola. Before OCR, upscale images below 1000px on the longest side to 1000px, estimate and correct skew within +/-15 degrees using Leptonica with confidence >= 2 and angle magnitude >= 0.5 degrees, and set resolution to 300dpi. The identical rule is applied to every image and its time is included.
